}}'''Vogeler''' is a [[Saldaean]] soldier who served under the command of [[Davram t'Ghaline Bashere|Davram Bashere]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Vogeler}}

== Activities ==
He witnessed [[Rand al'Thor]] defeat an entire [[Shadowspawn]] army single-handedly outside [[Maradon]]. He later discovered [[Vram Torkumen]], who had gouged out his own eyes due to being a [[Darkfriend]].

== Trivia ==
* Vogeler is named for Eric Vogeler, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
